mines.mine_notes: Guinea. Acquired via Robex merger (completed April 2026). Ramp-up continuing - gold poured rose 33% quarter-on-quarter to 64,026 oz group. Guinea introduced a local gold-refining-before-export requirement causing brief export pauses; shipments resumed, no material impact on 2026 guidance expected. Health & safety improved: zero recordable injuries. [production_notes: June 2026 quarter: 54,252 oz poured. Group H2 FY2026: 112,204 oz poured, 90,723 oz sold @ US$4,609/oz avg, US$418.1M revenue.] [primary_commodity: Gold] [cost_breakdown_notes: June 2026 quarter AISC US$1,254/oz. Mill processed 2.2 Mt @ 0.86 g/t, 90.5% recovery; throughput 1,113 tph (~9 Mtpa annualised) above 6.0 Mtpa nameplate.]

Mali. Acquired via Robex merger (completed April 2026). [production_notes: June 2026 quarter: 9,774 oz poured.] [primary_commodity: Gold] [cost_breakdown_notes: June 2026 quarter AISC US$1,974/oz. Mill processed 450,000 t @ 0.71 g/t.]

Guinea (Siguiri Basin). Flagship development: four deposits (NEB, BC, Fouwagbe, Sounsoun); environmental approval granted; exploitation permit applied January 2025, under government review as of July 2026. DFS (June 2025): avg ~250 kozpa over 12-yr life, NPV5% US$1.6B post-tax @ US$2,400/oz, IRR 46%. Two-year construction targeted from Q2 2026; commercial production expected Q2 2028. Key contracts awarded; detailed design commenced July 2026. FY2026 guidance (merged group): 198,000-220,000 oz @ group AISC US$1,300-1,500/oz; production expected to exceed 400 kozpa by 2029; combined resources ~9.5 Moz.
